resources.string: Tap a sender to read their messages.
Move to inbox puts all of a sender\'s messages in your inbox, then asks whether to always allow them.
Release once (touch and hold a message) puts only that message in your inbox. The sender is not allowed.
Swipe a sender toward the end of the row to move their messages to the inbox.
uMessage held these messages. They are not in your inbox.
This sender has no blocked messages now.
Strict: holds every unknown sender, verification codes too.
Smart: holds unknown senders, but lets codes without a link through.
Off: unknown senders reach your inbox. Your rules still apply.
